metadata.question: Did the regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland experience at least 45 centimeters of rainfall between January 27 to February 10, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use rainfall/precipitation data from NASA GPM or CHIRPS - Date range: January 27 to February 10, 2019 (15 days) - Locations: Mount Isa (approximately -20.73°S, 139.49°E) and Townsville (approximately -19.26°S, 146.82°E), Queensland, Australia - Need to check if cumulative rainfall >= 450mm (45 cm) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation products - Simply sum the precipitation over the date range 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Check if collection has images (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after reduction (C2) - If result is None or NaN, output C3 - If total rainfall >= 450mm for both locations, output A - Otherwise output B ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions mount_isa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.49, -20.73]) townsville = ee.Geometry.Point([146.82, -19.26]) start_date = '2019-01-27' end_date = '2019-02-11' # Exclusive end, so this captures through Feb 10 # 2. Data Acquisition - GPM IMERG Daily gpm = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') \ .filter(ee.Filter.date(start_date, end_date)) \ .select('precipitationCal') # Check collection size col_size = gpm.size().getInfo() print(f"GPM Images found: {col_size}") if col_size == 0: print("No precipitation data available for this period.") print("C1") else: # 3. Calculate total precipitation (sum over time period) # GPM precipitation is in mm/hr, need to multiply by 0.5 (30-min intervals) total_precip = gpm.sum() # 4. Extract values for both locations # Mount Isa isa_stats = total_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=mount_isa, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ) isa_precip = isa_stats.get('precipitationCal').getInfo() isa_count = total_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=mount_isa, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('precipitationCal').getInfo() # Townsville towns_stats = total_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=townsville, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ) towns_precip = towns_stats.get('precipitationCal').getInfo() towns_count = total_precip.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=townsville, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('precipitationCal').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Output print(f"Mount Isa - Pixels: {isa_count}, Total Precip: {isa_precip:.2f} mm") print(f"Townsville - Pixels: {towns_count}, Total Precip: {towns_precip:.2f} mm") # Check for C2 (no valid pixels) if isa_count == 0 or towns_count == 0: print("No valid pixels for one or both locations.") print("C2") # Check for C3 (invalid result) elif isa_precip is None or towns_precip is None: print("Calculation failed - returned None.") print("C3") # Check if both locations received >= 450mm (45 cm) elif isa_precip >= 450 and towns_precip >= 450: print("Both locations received at least 450mm of rainfall.") print("A") else: print("At least one location did not receive 450mm of rainfall.") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
mount_isa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.49, -20.73])
townsville = ee.Geometry.Point([146.82, -19.26])
start_date = '2019-01-27'
end_date = '2019-02-11'  # Exclusive end, so this captures through Feb 10

# 2. Data Acquisition - GPM IMERG Daily
gpm = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') \
    .filter(ee.Filter.date(start_date, end_date)) \
    .select('precipitationCal')

# Check collection size
col_size = gpm.size().getInfo()
print(f"GPM Images found: {col_size}")

if col_size == 0:
    print("No precipitation data available for this period.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Calculate total precipitation (sum over time period)
    # GPM precipitation is in mm/hr, need to multiply by 0.5 (30-min intervals)
    total_precip = gpm.sum()
    
    # 4. Extract values for both locations
    # Mount Isa
    isa_stats = total_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=mount_isa,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    isa_precip = isa_stats.get('precipitationCal').getInfo()
    isa_count = total_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=mount_isa,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('precipitationCal').getInfo()
    
    # Townsville
    towns_stats = total_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=townsville,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    towns_precip = towns_stats.get('precipitationCal').getInfo()
    towns_count = total_precip.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=townsville,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('precipitationCal').getInfo()
    
    # 5. Validation & Output
    print(f"Mount Isa - Pixels: {isa_count}, Total Precip: {isa_precip:.2f} mm")
    print(f"Townsville - Pixels: {towns_count}, Total Precip: {towns_precip:.2f} mm")
    
    # Check for C2 (no valid pixels)
    if isa_count == 0 or towns_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels for one or both locations.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    # Check for C3 (invalid result)
    elif isa_precip is None or towns_precip is None:
        print("Calculation failed - returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    # Check if both locations received >= 450mm (45 cm)
    elif isa_precip >= 450 and towns_precip >= 450:
        print("Both locations received at least 450mm of rainfall.")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("At least one location did not receive 450mm of rainfall.")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
